paymentResult.title: Payment result
paymentResult.verifying: Verifying your payment with the bank…
paymentResult.successBody: Your payment has been confirmed. Thank you!
paymentResult.pendingBody: The bank has not confirmed the payment yet. This can take a few minutes — you can retry the check below.
paymentResult.declinedBody: The payment was declined or cancelled. No money was taken for this attempt.
paymentResult.unknownBody: We weren't able to reach the bank to confirm your payment status right now. If it went through, your order or invoice will update automatically shortly. Please avoid paying again until then — check again below.
paymentResult.missingBody: This page didn't receive a payment reference, so there's nothing to verify here. If you were sent here after paying, check your invoices below.
